That transcription follows an American printing of the 1930s, which had drifted from Kingston in small ways and lost two passages of the last chapter. We read it against Kingston’s own 1891 Routledge printing (London), from a scan at the Internet Archive, and restored his words: the two passages, a dozen misprints, and about ninety places where a word had been dropped, added or changed.
